role: B鍗氬＋ / wild-path no-go stress test
polaris: Does any experimentally measurable input-side C_phi remain independent after measured normal-state baselines for c-axis coherence, disorder, oxygen stoichiometry, orbital/self-doping, strain, and pressure history are conditioned out?
framework: Response-kernel closure plus empirical non-identifiability; computational analogy: minimum sufficient statistic versus tautological full-state encoding.
findings: B revised final position remains an empirical non-identifiability/collapse claim, not a universal theorem. Formal collapse is tautological under B_plus/B_formal because the full normal-state response kernel contains the ingredients that generate P_oe. The experimentally meaningful claim is weaker: with a pre-registered measured B_min, C_phi/P_oe has no independent input-side content only if unsigned paired residuals and pre-registered null tests show R_oe annihilation out of sample within the thresholds below, without leakage, post-hoc direction choice, or residual absorption into U_miss.
math_object: Conditional sufficiency and residual annihilation: R_oe = P_oe - E_crossfit[P_oe | B_min], with B_plus used only for formal closure and B_min used only for empirical testing.
strangest_prediction: Among matched bilayer nickelate specimens with indistinguishable measured B_min, B predicts that pairwise residual magnitudes in P_oe shrink to measurement noise and that any signed pattern appears only under a P_oe/R_oe-blind, pre-frozen orientation rule. If B_min predicts residual annihilation under unsigned paired residual and permutation checks, C_phi is empirically non-identifiable as an independent input variable.
a_objection: A will argue that bilayer odd/even phase-transfer leaves a stable R_oe after all ordinary baselines are matched, especially in pairs with similar c-axis Drude weight and disorder but different odd/even susceptibility contrast.
failed_jumps: Universal no-go from Kubo closure failed: if the baseline includes the same kernel terms used to construct P_oe, collapse is tautological rather than experimentally decisive.
High-dimensional B_plus regression failed as an empirical design: n=12 cannot support unconstrained kernel-level fitting without absorbing the target post hoc.
Readiness labels based on later superconducting outcomes failed leakage control and are excluded.
next_plan: Run only the pre-registered B_min matched-pair residual-annihilation test. If the result falls in the gray zone, do not claim either independence or no-go; enlarge sample count and freeze the extraction code before repeating.
literature_needed: bilayer nickelate normal-state qz spectroscopy; La3Ni2O7-delta oxygen stoichiometry metrology; c-axis optical Drude weight under pressure; nickelate dz2 and rare-earth 5d self-doping; strain and pressure-path hysteresis in bilayer nickelates

allowed_claims: Conditional no-go under full normal-state kernel closure.
Empirical non-identifiability if measured B_min annihilates R_oe out of sample.
Current nickelate constraints make independent C_phi unproven unless residual survival passes the stated thresholds.
forbidden_claims: Universal theorem that all possible C_phi variables collapse.
Claim that P_oe is impossible or meaningless.
Claim that B_plus collapse is experimental evidence.
Use of Tc, zero resistance, Meissner response, critical current, gap opening, or historical superconducting labels in selection, fitting, stopping, or Z_pre definition.

B_plus_or_B_formal.definition: Omniscient full normal-state response-kernel state, including matrix elements M_even/odd, self-energies Sigma_even/odd, vertex/dephasing kernels Gamma_vertex_even/odd, all structural disorder fields, oxygen configuration, strain tensor, orbital occupancy, pressure path, and probe calibration.
B_plus_or_B_formal.permitted_use: Formal conditional statement: if P_oe is a deterministic or noisy function of the complete normal-state response kernel and measurement noise is conditionally independent of pre-output Z_pre, then I(C_phi; Z_pre | B_plus) = 0.
B_plus_or_B_formal.forbidden_use: Do not use B_plus as the empirical baseline, because it contains target-generating kernel components and can absorb P_oe by construction.

B_min.definition: Pre-registered experimentally measured baseline vector, acquired independently of P_oe extraction and before any superconducting-output information is used.

components.name: oxygen_stoichiometry_and_layer_asymmetry
allowed_probes: neutron or synchrotron refinement where available
components.matching_rule: within 1 sigma metrology uncertainty or pre-registered delta_O tolerance, whichever is stricter

components.name: strain_and_lattice_geometry
components.matching_rule: Mahalanobis distance in standardized geometry subspace <= 1.0

components.name: orbital_self_doping
allowed_probes: ARPES where surface validity is documented
components.matching_rule: standardized subspace distance <= 1.0 and same sign of carrier-density offset

components.name: dephasing_disorder
allowed_probes: quantum oscillation Dingle proxy if available

components.name: pressure_and_thermal_path
components.matching_rule: same pressure protocol class and pressure difference <= 0.2 GPa or <= 1 sigma pressure uncertainty

components.name: ordinary_c_axis_coherence
allowed_probes: optical conductivity acquired independently of odd/even susceptibility decomposition
normal-state qz scattering width only when reduced to a frozen low-dimensional coherence proxy independent of P_oe target extraction
components.leakage_guard: The qz/c-axis coherence proxy must be acquired independently from, or reduced by a pre-frozen pipeline separate from, the odd/even susceptibility decomposition used to compute P_oe. It may not reuse target-generating susceptibility data, odd/even matrix-element fits, probe-calibration matrices, window tuning, or residual-informed preprocessing from P_oe extraction.

exclusions: No P_oe-derived odd/even contrast terms inside B_min.
No fitted matrix elements from the same susceptibility decomposition used to compute P_oe.
No qz/c-axis coherence proxy that reuses target-generating odd/even susceptibility data, calibration matrices, or extraction-window choices.
No superconducting output variables or labels.
No post-hoc feature selection after seeing P_oe or R_oe.

P_oe.chi_requirement: chi_odd and chi_even must be the same normal-state susceptibility component, integrated over the same pre-registered q, omega, polarization, and temperature window.
P_oe.temperature_window: normal state only; exclude superconducting fluctuation regime and any window chosen using Tc or later superconducting output

denominator_floor_rule.definition: Let S = chi_odd + chi_even in the registered integration window and S_ref = median_abs(S) across calibration specimens/probe repeats before hypothesis testing. The effective denominator is sign(S) * max(abs(S), S_floor).
denominator_floor_rule.exclusion: If abs(S) < S_floor for both technical repeats or if sign(S) is not repeat-stable, P_oe is marked denominator-ill-conditioned and excluded before model fitting.
denominator_floor_rule.reporting: Report excluded fraction. If more than 20 percent of specimens are excluded, the round outcome is protocol failure, not B no-go.

R_oe.model_rule: E_crossfit is trained without specimen i and without its matched partner. Model class, feature transforms, and regularization are frozen before seeing R_oe.

eta.normalization: eta is dimensionless and lives on the same normalized P_oe residual scale.
eta.scale_rule: U_miss, epsilon_meas, and R_oe are all reported in units of normalized P_oe. epsilon_meas is estimated from technical repeats and propagated through the denominator-floor rule.
eta.B_interpretation: B predicts eta contains no stable R_oe after B_min cross-fitted conditioning; remaining eta may be attributed to pre-bounded U_miss plus epsilon_meas only inside the frozen uncertainty envelope. Residuals outside that envelope must enter survival or gray-zone criteria and cannot be absorbed post hoc.

U_miss_rule.source: U_miss is bounded before P_oe/R_oe inspection from independent metrology uncertainty, external covariance estimates, or a pre-registered sensitivity grid over plausible missing baseline components.
U_miss_rule.upper_bound: For each specimen or pair, report U_miss_max on the normalized P_oe scale. The combined envelope is sigma_total_j = sqrt(sigma_res_j^2 + U_miss_max_j^2) or the pre-registered conservative linear sum if covariance is unknown.
U_miss_rule.freeze_rule: U_miss_max, covariance assumptions, and sensitivity-grid endpoints are frozen before residuals are computed and cannot be enlarged after seeing R_oe, Delta_r_pair, or pooled shifts.
U_miss_rule.decision_rule: Residual magnitude beyond the frozen U_miss + epsilon_meas envelope counts toward residual survival or gray-zone; it is not reclassified as missing-baseline uncertainty.

kubo_closure_status.statement: The Kubo/response-kernel argument is a sufficiency closure, not a dimensionally complete theorem. If the full normal-state kernel state is included in B_plus, then P_oe is generated by B_plus plus measurement noise.
not_claimed: No complete SI-normalized susceptibility derivation is claimed.
No proof that measured B_min equals the full kernel state is claimed.
No inference from B_plus closure to empirical no-go is allowed without B_min residual annihilation.
kubo_closure_status.formal_closure: If C_phi = F(P_oe, other pre-output probes), P_oe = H(B_plus, epsilon_meas), other probes = G(B_plus, epsilon_other), and measurement noises are conditionally independent of Z_pre, then I(C_phi; Z_pre | B_plus) = 0.

matched_pair_design.material_scope: La3Ni2O7-delta and closely related bilayer nickelates only; do not pool single-layer, infinite-layer, or chemically unrelated systems unless declared as negative controls.
matched_pair_design.minimum_pilot: 12 specimens arranged as 6 matched pairs across at least 2 synthesis/measurement batches.
matched_pair_design.preferred_decision_sample: 24 specimens arranged as 12 matched pairs across at least 3 batches if available; pilot thresholds below remain valid but gray-zone repeat is mandatory for n=12.
matched_pair_design.pairing_rule: Pairs are chosen by B_min distance before P_oe is computed. Matching must satisfy every component rule or be rejected. Pair left/right orientation is frozen before P_oe extraction using a P_oe/R_oe-blind deterministic rule such as acquisition timestamp, specimen registry ID, or a pre-declared independent X_pre_not_in_B_min axis; if no such axis is scientifically justified, signed direction is not interpreted.
matched_pair_design.residual_annihilation_prediction_by_B: Primary B prediction uses unsigned paired residuals: abs(Delta_r_pair_j) = abs(R_oe_left_j - R_oe_right_j) should be <= 2 * sigma_total_j for most pairs, where sigma_total includes frozen measurement and U_miss envelopes. Signed patterns are evaluated only under the pre-frozen P_oe/R_oe-blind orientation rule and are secondary.
matched_pair_design.survival_prediction_against_B: Residual survival against B requires excess unsigned paired residual magnitude, pooled residual shift, or a pre-registered permutation/hierarchical test rejecting the measurement-error-plus-U_miss null. Same-sign survival is allowed only if the sign direction is determined before P_oe extraction by an independent X_pre_not_in_B_min axis that is not used to fit B_min.
overfit_controls: Maximum effective degrees of freedom <= number_of_pairs / 3 for the pilot.
No feature selection after viewing P_oe residuals.
External or replicate calibration required for measurement-error covariance.
Report negative CV-R2 as zero explanatory support, not as evidence for independence.

Delta_r_pair_direction_rule.primary_test: Use direction-free abs(Delta_r_pair) and a paired permutation or hierarchical measurement-error null as the primary residual-survival test.
Delta_r_pair_direction_rule.signed_test: A signed Delta_r_pair test is permitted only if left/right orientation and any same-sign hypothesis are frozen before P_oe extraction by specimen registry/acquisition order or an independent X_pre_not_in_B_min axis. The rule must not depend on P_oe, R_oe, residual magnitude, superconducting output, or conclusion-favorable ordering.
Delta_r_pair_direction_rule.no_posthoc_direction: If the orientation rule was not frozen before P_oe extraction, report only unsigned paired residual magnitude and permutation/hierarchical p-values; do not interpret left/right sign or same-sign patterns.

criteria_all_required: At least 5 of 6 pilot pairs or at least 10 of 12 preferred pairs satisfy abs(Delta_r_pair) <= 2 * sigma_total, where sigma_total includes frozen epsilon_meas and U_miss envelopes.
Pre-registered paired permutation/hierarchical measurement-error null is not rejected for excess residual survival after B_min conditioning.

If and only if a P_oe/R_oe-blind signed orientation was frozen before P_oe extraction, no same-direction signed residual survival appears in more than one third of pairs; otherwise no signed conclusion is reported.
abs(mean(R_oe)) < 0.05 and abs(pooled matched residual shift) < 0.05 on normalized P_oe scale.
Cross-validated R2 for P_oe from B_min >= 0.85, or CV-R2 >= 0.65 with residual-pair collapse and bootstrap 95 percent CI for pooled residual shift contained within [-0.05, 0.05].
Negative controls and batch/sample-quality/probe-calibration reports show no artificial residual survival or collapse.
collapse_no_go_table.allowed_conclusion: C_phi/P_oe is empirically non-identifiable as an independent input-side variable under the measured B_min protocol. Stop phase-bus claims for this material window unless a new independent observable is proposed.
collapse_no_go_table.forbidden_conclusion: Universal impossibility theorem for all C_phi.

collapse_no_go_table.outcome: Residual survival / B falsified for this protocol
criteria_any_sufficient_with_leakage_cle: Unsigned abs(Delta_r_pair) >= 3 * sigma_total in at least 4 of 6 pilot pairs or at least 7 of 12 preferred pairs.
Pre-registered paired permutation or hierarchical measurement-error-plus-U_miss null is rejected for excess residual magnitude at the frozen alpha level.
Pooled matched residual shift >= 0.10 on normalized P_oe scale with bootstrap 95 percent CI excluding 0.
Cross-validated partial R2 of residual predictor not contained in B_min >= 0.10 with bootstrap 95 percent CI excluding 0.
If a P_oe/R_oe-blind X_pre_not_in_B_min orientation was frozen before extraction, residual sign remains stable under leave-one-batch-out analysis.
collapse_no_go_table.allowed_conclusion: Measured B_min does not annihilate R_oe; B's empirical collapse claim fails for this protocol. This permits, but does not prove, an independent input-side phase-transfer residual.
collapse_no_go_table.forbidden_conclusion: Validated superconducting predictor or proof of phase-bus mechanism.

criteria_any: 0.65 < CV-R2 < 0.85 while pairwise and pooled residual criteria disagree.
2 to 3 of 6 pilot pairs, or 4 to 6 of 12 preferred pairs, show unsigned abs(Delta_r_pair) >= 3 * sigma_total.
Pooled residual shift is between 0.05 and 0.10 or its bootstrap CI overlaps 0.
Negative CV-R2, unstable feature weights, or residual signs that change under the pre-frozen signed orientation in leave-one-batch-out analysis.
Denominator-ill-conditioned exclusions exceed 10 percent but do not exceed 20 percent.
U_miss sensitivity envelope is too wide to distinguish collapse from survival but was frozen before residual inspection.
collapse_no_go_table.allowed_conclusion: Inconclusive. Freeze code and extraction windows, increase matched-pair count, improve metrology, and repeat. Do not claim either no-go or independent C_phi.
collapse_no_go_table.forbidden_conclusion: Selective interpretation based on whichever statistic favors A or B.

criteria_any: Any superconducting output leakage in selection, labels, fitting, or stopping.
P_oe extraction windows changed after seeing residuals.
B_min includes fitted odd/even kernel terms derived from the same P_oe contrast.
B_min qz/c-axis coherence proxy shares target-generating information with odd/even susceptibility extraction.
Matched pairs fail pre-registered B_min distance thresholds.
Pair orientation, same-sign direction, U_miss envelope, or residual-survival alpha level is chosen after seeing P_oe or R_oe.
collapse_no_go_table.allowed_conclusion: No decision about C_phi. Redesign protocol.
collapse_no_go_table.forbidden_conclusion: No-go, survival, or gray-zone scientific inference.

negative_controls.name: scrambled_pair_control
negative_controls.design: Randomly permute pair labels within batch after B_min measurement.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: Residual annihilation should not look stronger than in true B_min-matched pairs.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: If scrambled pairs perform equally well, the matching design has low discriminating power.

negative_controls.name: single_layer_or_non_bilayer_control
negative_controls.design: Apply the same P_oe extraction machinery to a material/window without bilayer odd/even parity structure.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: No stable R_oe survival; any apparent P_oe should be denominator-noise or matrix-element artifact.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: Stable residual indicates extraction artifact or unmodeled probe asymmetry.

negative_controls.name: high_disorder_control
negative_controls.design: Use specimens with intentionally broad disorder/dephasing where phase-sensitive bilayer contrast should be washed out.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: B_min disorder/dephasing terms explain apparent contrast; residuals collapse.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: Residual survival in this control suggests hidden calibration or denominator artifacts.

negative_controls.name: probe_window_control
negative_controls.design: Repeat extraction in an adjacent normal-state q, omega, polarization window not expected to carry bilayer parity-transfer information.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: No stable residual after B_min conditioning.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: Window-independent residuals favor sample-quality or probe-systematic explanations, not independent C_phi.

negative_controls.name: batch_stratified_control
negative_controls.design: Repeat residual-annihilation and survival tests within batch and leave-one-batch-out; include at least two pilot batches and preferably three decision batches.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: Collapse or survival calls must not be driven by a single synthesis or measurement batch.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: Batch-specific residual patterns indicate synthesis/probe batch effects rather than a clean C_phi residual decision.

negative_controls.name: sample_quality_repeatability_report
negative_controls.design: Report same-batch technical repeat P_oe repeatability, denominator-ill-conditioned exclusions versus sample-quality metrics, and disorder/dephasing correlations.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: Residual calls remain stable after accounting for sample-quality metrics and technical repeat variance.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: Residual survival or collapse tracks sample quality rather than B_min-conditioned odd/even physics.

negative_controls.name: probe_calibration_blank_or_reference
negative_controls.design: Run blank/reference-standard probe calibration through the frozen P_oe pipeline and report calibration drift, matrix asymmetry, and window-dependent artifacts.
negative_controls.B_expected_result: Calibration blanks/reference standards produce no stable P_oe-like residual after the frozen denominator and B_min rules.
negative_controls.failure_meaning: Stable residual in calibration controls indicates probe or matrix-element artifact.

allowed: Pre-output normal-state structural, spectroscopic, and transport observables measured before superconducting-output knowledge enters analysis.
Readiness labels only if assigned by a frozen rule from allowed pre-output observables.
forbidden: retrospective labels based on historical or later superconducting behavior
manual labels assigned after seeing superconducting outcomes

formulae: P_oe = (chi_odd - chi_even) / (sign(S) * max(abs(S), S_floor)), S = chi_odd + chi_even, S_floor = max(5 sigma_S, 0.05 S_ref)
Delta_r_pair_j is tested primarily as abs(R_oe_left_j - R_oe_right_j); signed tests require a P_oe/R_oe-blind pre-frozen orientation rule
eta = U_miss + epsilon_meas + R_oe, with U_miss bounded independently before residual inspection
I(C_phi; Z_pre | B_plus) = 0 only under full-kernel closure and conditionally independent measurement noise
INSPECTOR_CHECK.direction: B predicts measured B_min annihilates R_oe within the frozen epsilon_meas + U_miss envelope under direction-free paired residual and permutation/hierarchical null tests. Stable signed residuals falsify B only when the sign axis was frozen before P_oe extraction by P_oe/R_oe-blind information.
INSPECTOR_CHECK.data: No new external data used in Round 3; this is a pre-registered decision and collapse/no-go table built from Round 2 synthesis and B inspector warnings.
assumptions: chi_odd and chi_even are measured in the same normal-state convention.
B_min is measured independently of P_oe extraction and its qz/c-axis proxy does not reuse target-generating odd/even susceptibility information.
Superconducting output leakage is absent.
Cross-fitting, matching, pair orientation, U_miss bounds, and residual-survival tests are frozen before residual interpretation.
U_miss is independently bounded and cannot be enlarged after seeing R_oe.
Batch/sample-quality/probe-calibration negative controls are reported.
Kubo closure is schematic and conditional, not a complete theorem.

claims.statement: B_plus collapse is formally valid only as a tautological full-kernel sufficiency closure and must not be treated as experimental evidence.
assumptions: B_plus contains the full normal-state response kernel
measurement noise is conditionally independent of Z_pre
Z_pre is output-leakage-free

claims.statement: Measured B_min gives an empirical collapse test: if cross-fitted residual R_oe is annihilated in matched pairs, C_phi/P_oe is non-identifiable as an independent input-side variable for this nickelate window.
assumptions: B_min features are pre-registered
matched-pair thresholds are met
model complexity is controlled
negative controls pass

claims.statement: Excess unsigned paired R_oe after B_min matching, or stable signed R_oe under a pre-frozen independent orientation axis, falsifies B's empirical collapse but only permits an independent residual claim; it does not validate superconducting prediction or a phase-bus mechanism.
equations: signed Delta_r_pair only under a pre-frozen P_oe/R_oe-blind orientation rule
assumptions: No output leakage
denominator floor passed
U_miss bound frozen before residual inspection
residual survives batch and negative-control checks

claims.statement: Gray-zone outcomes must be classified as inconclusive/repeat rather than selectively converted into either collapse or survival.
assumptions: Pilot sample remains small
bootstrap and batch analyses are fragile under n=12

revision_notes: Fixed the Round 3 blocker by removing post-hoc signed pair interpretation. Delta_r_pair is now either oriented by a frozen P_oe/R_oe-blind rule or evaluated with unsigned paired residual magnitude plus a pre-registered permutation/hierarchical null.

Deleted the mathematically invalid signed absolute-value language and replaced survival/collapse criteria with unsigned magnitude, pooled shift, and optional sign tests tied only to an independent frozen X_pre_not_in_B_min axis.
Corrected INSPECTOR_CHECK P_oe parentheses to divide by (sign(S) * max(abs(S), S_floor)).
Added explicit leakage guard that B_min c-axis/qz coherence proxies cannot share target-generating data, decomposition, calibration matrices, or window tuning with odd/even susceptibility extraction.
Added an independent U_miss upper-bound/sensitivity rule: it is frozen before residuals are seen and cannot absorb residual survival post hoc.
Added batch, sample-quality, and probe-calibration negative-control/reporting requirements.
